name: Sharptalon's Claw
summary: In Ashenvale, Sharptalon's attacks put Horde supply lines at risk. Bring its claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post as proof that the predator has fallen.

sections.title: A Scourge of the Forest Trails
sections.body: Sharptalon hunts the paths to Splintertree Post while the Horde seeks resources in Ashenvale. The aggressive hippogryph strikes peons and couriers traveling between forward logging camps and the outpost. Its attacks hinder Horde work in the region. Night elven sentinels and dangerous wildlife threaten the newcomers as well.

sections.title: Proof of the Hunt
sections.body: Senani Thunderheart, a tauren huntress, directs Horde hunters against Ashenvale's deadliest predators. Sharptalon's talon proves the hippogryph has fallen. Bring the trophy to Splintertree Post. The outpost's defenders honor the hunt, and frightened laborers can walk the woods with less fear.

aliases: what kind of beast is sharptalon
faq.answer: Sharptalon is a fierce, predatory hippogryph that hunts in Ashenvale. It ambushes travelers moving through the forest.

faq.q: Why does Senani Thunderheart want the claw?
faq.answer: Senani Thunderheart wants the claw as proof Sharptalon has been killed. The predator threatens Horde workers and supply routes.

faq.q: Where do I turn in Sharptalon's Claw?
faq.answer: Bring the claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: How does killing Sharptalon help the Horde?
faq.answer: Sharptalon attacks peons traveling between remote lumber mills and Splintertree Post. Killing it makes travel safer for supplies, lumber, and messengers.

faq.q: Is this quest part of a larger chain?
faq.answer: Yes. It belongs to The Ashenvale Hunt, Senani Thunderheart's series of beast hunts. The series ends with The Hunt Completed.
Senani Thunderheart is a tauren huntress at Splintertree Post. She watches the forest's balance and tests Horde hunters against Ashenvale's most dangerous creatures.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help secure trails for Warsong lumber operations. You protect peons traveling between forward outposts and Splintertree Post.
As a hunter, you test your tracking and marksmanship against Sharptalon, a feared flying predator beneath Ashenvale's thick canopy.
As a tauren, you follow Senani Thunderheart's hunt and test yourself against nature's fiercest beasts, as tauren tradition demands.
As an orc, you ease the Warsong clan's hard work gathering wood by removing an aerial threat from the forest.
